jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Order

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "credit_card":     {"type": "string"},
    "billing_address": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "dependentRequired": {
    "credit_card": ["billing_address"]
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/orderpkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestOrder_NoDependents(t *testing.T) {
	var o Order
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{}`), &o); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal({}): %v", err)
	}
}

func TestOrder_WithDependent(t *testing.T) {
	var o Order
	in := []byte(`{"credit_card":"4242","billing_address":"1 Main"}`)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &o); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestOrder_MissingDependent(t *testing.T) {
	var o Order
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"credit_card":"4242"}`), &o)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want dependentRequired rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "billing_address") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want mention of billing_address", err)
	}
}
